facts.text: The Go Blue Guarantee is UM-Dearborn's commitment to cover undergraduate tuition and mandatory university fees for up to four years for qualifying students.

facts.text: The Go Blue Guarantee covers free tuition at UM-Dearborn for in-state undergraduate students with family income and assets of $125,000 or less and an incoming 3.5 GPA.

sources.title: Go Blue Guarantee | University of Michigan-Dearborn
sources.quote: Students at UM-Dearborn are eligible for the Go Blue Guarantee - University of Michigan's landmark promise of free tuition for high-achieving in-state undergraduate students from qualifying backgrounds.
